parameters.name: CharacterType
parameters.description: The node type. Valid values: polarx\_cn, polarx\_dn, polarx\_cdc, polarx\_gms, and polarx\_columnar.

parameters.name: DBInstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the PolarDB-X instance.

parameters.name: DBNodeIds
parameters.description: The node names. Separate multiple names with commas (,). You can specify up to 10 CDC nodes or compute nodes at a time, and up to 1 data node at a time.

parameters.name: DBNodeRole
parameters.description:
The node role. Valid values:
- master: primary node.
- slave: secondary node. Applies to DN and GMS nodes.
- standby: secondary node. Applies to CN nodes.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. Format: YYYY-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC).

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: The metric names. Separate multiple names with commas (,). You can specify up to 6 metrics. For more information, see [Performance metrics](~~332726~~).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. Format: YYYY-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC).
